verdict.rationale: Webhooks are a fair axis for an application monitoring platform like Sentry, but the evidence pack never mentions registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The items cover agent tracing, dashboards, SDK instrumentation, the CLI and community self-hosting experiences, none of which show webhook delivery, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
